identitySignals: Oakland Unity High School is a public charter high school in Oakland, CA (6038 Brann St), matching the agenda name exactly (unityhigh.org About page)
GuideStar lists the nonprofit Unity Schools (EIN 75-3107384), website UNITYHIGH.ORG, as the operator of Oakland Unity High School (OUHS) and Oakland Unity Middle School
ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer lists Unity Schools as a 501(c)(3) educational nonprofit in Oakland, CA operating a high school
OUSD's Measure N page says charter schools receive Measure N funds, consistent with a Measures N and H MOU between OUSD and a charter high school
research.notes: Legal name 'Unity Schools' is the IRS-registered nonprofit; the school's site refers to 'Oakland Unity Charter Schools'. The agenda MOU counterparty is named 'Oakland Unity High School'. The address shown is the school site; GuideStar lists a different business address (410 7th St Ste 204b, Oakland). California Secretary of State entity number not checked (registry not fetchable).

profile.summary: Oakland Unity High School is a public charter high school in Oakland, California, serving about 350 students in grades 9 to 12. It offers a college preparatory program and a career technical pathway in Information Technology and Digital Media. It is run by Unity Schools, a nonprofit that also operates Oakland Unity Middle School.

review.notes: The school site, GuideStar and ProPublica agree that Oakland Unity High School is an OUSD-authorized public charter run by the Oakland nonprofit Unity Schools (EIN 75-3107384), which fits a Measures N and H MOU. Summary, contact details and EIN are all shown on the cited pages and the summary is neutral; the school address differs from the GuideStar business address, but the profile notes this.
